description: This file defines the main layout component for a Next.js web application, including metadata, font setup, initial property fetching, and rendering of the HTML structure with embedded components and styles.

methods.name: getInitialProps
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches initial properties such as locale, direction, embed status, and embed color scheme based on request headers.

methods.name: RootLayout
methods.description: Main layout component that renders the HTML structure, including head and body, with embedded components and styles, based on initial properties.
